content.text: {"pagination":{"count":10,"page":1,"next_page":2,"total_count":1000,"total_pages":100},"records":[{"platform":"desktop","title":"Playful","url":"https://playful.software","uuid":"749da11c-6bc7-4c1b-b111-333882d1b828","preview_url":"https://images.refero.design/styles/playful.software/749da11c-6bc7-4c1b-b111-333882d1b828/preview_0.jpg","description":"A playful, modern landing-page aesthetic with a soft editorial feel and a polished startup-brand finish. The interface sits on a warm off-white canvas with a large pastel gradient wash that blooms from pink into lilac and peach, giving the whole composition a dreamy, airy energy. Typography is bold, compact, and highly expressive: oversized black italic headlines create a strong, confident focal point, while smaller supporting copy stays restrained and clean for contrast. The layout is centered and spacious, with generous breathing room between sections and a calm, uncluttered hierarchy. Rounded pill controls and soft, rounded input fields add to the friendly tone, with bright Vivacious Pink used sparingly as the primary interactive accent and call-to-action color. Product imagery appears as a row of overlapping rounded app tiles, rendered like glossy mini illustrations or icon cards, adding a tactile, collectible feel. The FAQ and footer areas continue the same minimal, refined language with light surfaces, subtle dividers, and compact accordion rows. Overall it feels cheerful, modern, and slightly whimsical, balancing playful color and graphic energy with disciplined spacing and strong typographic structure."},{"platform":"desktop","title":"Palette Supply","url":"https://palette.supply","uuid":"e6480a41-836a-4651-b3bc-6732d1fef041","preview_url":"https://images.refero.design/styles/palette.supply/e6480a41-836a-4651-b3bc-6732d1fef041/preview_0.jpg","description":"A warm, minimalist creative-tool aesthetic with a soft off-white canvas and a playful scatter of rounded color blocks floating across the screen. The composition feels airy and editorial, with lots of negative space and a calm, matte surface treatment that lets the palette itself become the hero. Colors are muted and earthy at the base—sage green, clay, sand, beige, dusty rose—punctuated by a few brighter accent notes like mustard and indigo for energy. Typography is crisp and understated, with a clean monospaced/product-style wordmark centered prominently for a distinctly modern design-studio feel. The layout is loose and full-bleed rather than boxed in, giving the page an immersive, poster-like quality. Overall it feels friendly, tactile, and curated, like a brand system or palette exploration interface with strong visual personality and gentle, rounded geometry."},{"platform":"desktop","title":"Gumroad","url":"https://gumroad.com","uuid":"ac783c6e-6c2b-4663-87b3-bcd12d463b0a","preview_url":"https://images.refero.design/styles/gumroad.com/ac783c6e-6c2b-4663-87b3-bcd12d463b0a/preview_0.jpg","description":"A stark, high-contrast landing-page aesthetic with a playful digital-brand twist. The interface sits on a warm off-white canvas, paired with heavy black typography and crisp black dividers, creating a clean editorial structure with a utilitarian edge. Large, centered hero copy dominates the composition, using a bold geometric sans-serif that feels modern and highly legible, with tight spacing and confident scale. The layout is spacious and contained, with generous breathing room around the content and a clear vertical rhythm that makes the page feel calm despite the strong contrast.\n\nThe visual identity is defined by vivid hot-pink illustrated coins floating around the page like sticker-like mascots. These outlined, slightly isometric graphics add motion and personality without cluttering the structure, and their glossy neon pink hue gives the whole screen a signature creator-platform energy. The navigation and CTAs are minimal and sharp: black primary buttons, pill-shaped dark tabs, and restrained outlined controls, all reinforcing a polished, no-frills hierarchy. Card surfaces below continue the same language with rounded corners, thin borders, and light backgrounds, keeping the design airy and uncluttered. Overall it feels like a playful but disciplined startup brand system — bold, graphic, and memorable, with an intentionally simple black-white-pink palette and a strong sense of visual clarity."},{"platform":"desktop","title":"Lpalo","url":"https://lpalo.com","uuid":"8033959a-dffa-4da0-b700-1af46f13c51f","preview_url":"https://images.refero.design/styles/lpalo.com/8033959a-dffa-4da0-b700-1af46f13c51f/preview_0.jpg","description":"A soft, playful editorial landing page with a warm blush-pink canvas and a bold, high-contrast typographic hero. The overall feel is light, friendly, and whimsical, but anchored by oversized black display lettering that gives the composition a confident, poster-like presence. The layout is spacious and centered, with a clear top navigation row made of pill-shaped white buttons outlined in black, creating a tidy, approachable header. Around the hero, small outline illustrations add scattered decorative energy — tiny robots, headphones, and quirky objects drawn with thin black strokes and small pastel fills in blue, orange, mint, and coral. The visual language is deliberately simple and graphic: flat color blocks, rounded corners, minimal surface treatment, and no heavy depth effects. The large headline dominates the screen, while the playful accents keep the page feeling youthful, creative, and slightly mischievous, like a children’s media brand with strong editorial styling. Overall it balances softness and boldness through blush backgrounds, chunky typography, clean spacing, and cheerful illustrated details."},{"platform":"desktop","title":"Whimsical","url":"https://whimsical.com","uuid":"3e8e4b3b-1cda-4467-ba17-376ef446904a","preview_url":"https://images.refero.design/styles/whimsical.com/3e8e4b3b-1cda-4467-ba17-376ef446904a/preview_0.jpg","description":"Whimsical has a bright, playful productivity-studio aesthetic with a soft luxury feel: airy white space, plush rounded corners, and a vivid violet-to-fuchsia brand palette that gives the interface a dreamy, creative energy. The overall layout is clean and centered, with a strong editorial hierarchy and generous breathing room that keeps the design feeling light despite the rich color accents. Typography is bold and confident in the headlines, paired with a highly readable sans serif for supporting copy, creating a polished contrast between expressive display moments and practical clarity. Surfaces are smooth and tactile, often presented as rounded cards or large pill-shaped panels with subtle elevation and diffused shadows, reinforcing the friendly, approachable tone. The hero sections feel especially immersive, using large gradient backgrounds and oversized mockups to create a sense of momentum and visual depth. Smaller UI details, like outlined icons, compact buttons, and delicate dividers, stay understated so the brand colors and rounded forms remain the focus. Overall it feels modern, inviting, and slightly whimsical, like a creative collaboration tool wrapped in a premium, cushiony visual language."},{"platform":"desktop","title":"Canva","url":"https://canva.com","uuid":"7ddc3ee2-dde2-4365-aa87-ed08f9a47dd0","preview_url":"https://images.refero.design/styles/canva.com/7ddc3ee2-dde2-4365-aa87-ed08f9a47dd0/preview_0.jpg","description":"A vibrant creative-platform aesthetic with a playful, high-energy brand feel. The visual language is built around a luminous purple-to-blue gradient hero that melts into teal and pale sky tones, creating a bright, optimistic backdrop for large centered headlines and lightweight supporting copy. Typography is clean, modern, and sans-serif, with generous spacing and a friendly, approachable tone that still feels polished and premium. The header is minimal and airy, with small text links and compact pill-like buttons that sit quietly against the vivid background. Below the hero, the layout shifts into colorful editorial-style content blocks and rounded cards arranged in a balanced grid, mixing full-bleed gradients, saturated color panels, and white surfaces. The cards are highly visual and image-led, often featuring bold product mockups, cropped illustrations, and expressive 3D-like elements layered over rich gradients. Rounded corners are consistent across buttons, cards, and embedded UI, giving everything a soft, accessible finish. Overall it feels cheerful, imaginative, and slightly futuristic — a design toolkit brand with strong visual confidence, abundant color, and a smooth, modern digital polish."},{"platform":"desktop","title":"Bento","url":"https://www.bento.me","uuid":"a5c9749d-d7ca-4bfc-bc4d-48da02d0669b","preview_url":"https://images.refero.design/styles/www.bento.me/a5c9749d-d7ca-4bfc-bc4d-48da02d0669b/preview_0.jpg","description":"Bright, playful Linktree-style landing-page design with a loud, high-contrast color system and a very soft, rounded geometry language. The overall feel is energetic and youthful, built from flat, saturated section backgrounds in chartreuse, cobalt blue, and deep crimson, paired with crisp white surfaces and dark ink text. Typography is oversized, bold, and highly confident, with chunky headline treatment and tight spacing that creates a strong editorial punch. Navigation sits inside a long pill-shaped white bar, giving the interface a friendly, approachable silhouette, while the primary button treatment is equally pill-like and visually assertive. Cards and media tiles use generous corner radii, from large rounded rectangles to nearly circular pills, reinforcing the brand’s bouncy, tactile personality. Imagery is prominent and contained in rounded frames, often full-bleed within card shapes, with a polished, creator-focused look. The composition is spacious and sectioned, with clear blocks of color and simple, lightweight controls that rely on hue and shape rather than shadows or heavy borders. Overall it feels vibrant, modular, and optimistic, like a modern creator-product aesthetic with a bold playful edge."},{"platform":"desktop","title":"Linktr","url":"https://linktr.ee","uuid":"a49fa15d-5893-4d1d-98f6-4120131059f2","preview_url":"https://images.refero.design/styles/linktr.ee/a49fa15d-5893-4d1d-98f6-4120131059f2/preview_0.jpg","description":"A vibrant, high-energy brand landing page with a playful link-in-bio aesthetic. The visual language is built from loud, saturated color blocks—especially chartreuse lime, vivid blue, and deep red—set against a light marble-like canvas. Large rounded sections, pill-shaped buttons, and oversized organic corner radii give the interface a soft, friendly feel, while the bold contrast makes it feel punchy and modern. Typography is heavy, chunky, and highly legible, with big display headlines in a confident sans style and smaller supporting copy kept clean and functional. The layout is spacious but structured, using centered containers, wide hero bands, and alternating color-split sections to keep the page visually energetic. Cards and panels are rounded and tactile, often filled with solid brand colors rather than shadows, creating depth through contrast instead of elevation. Imagery is integrated as polished product and lifestyle photography with a playful, colorful treatment, reinforcing a creator-first, expressive digital identity. Overall it feels like a bright, contemporary productivity brand with a youthful, editorial, and slightly whimsical tone."},{"platform":"desktop","title":"Martin Laxenaire","url":"https://www.martin-laxenaire.fr","uuid":"cb3f66cb-7142-4e6f-a303-bf0e0203b6b2","preview_url":"https://images.refero.design/styles/www.martin-laxenaire.fr/cb3f66cb-7142-4e6f-a303-bf0e0203b6b2/preview_0.jpg","description":"A bright, high-energy designer portfolio aesthetic with a clean white canvas and bold, graphic typography. The layout is minimal and centered, giving the hero artwork plenty of room to dominate the screen. At the top, a compact wordmark and a tiny progress pill create a restrained, editorial header treatment. The main visual is a large abstract burst of wavy organic shapes in electric blue, purple, pink, and teal, arranged like radiating paper-cut ribbons around a central message. Over this, oversized black display lettering with thick outlines and a slightly slanted, poster-like attitude creates a loud, playful focal point. The typography feels ultra-bold, expressive, and retro-futuristic, with strong contrast against the light background. The overall look is crisp, clean, and youthful, balancing structured spacing and simple UI details with flamboyant color and motion-like energy. The result feels like a modern creative studio identity: punchy, graphic, and confidently unconventional."},{"platform":"desktop","title":"Figma","url":"https://www.figma.com","uuid":"d570f865-57a7-4fca-9968-ce59056a35dc","preview_url":"https://images.refero.design/styles/www.figma.com/d570f865-57a7-4fca-9968-ce59056a35dc/preview_0.jpg","description":"A bright, minimalist product-marketing aesthetic with a clean editorial feel and a strong creative-tool identity. The interface is built on a white canvas with lots of open space, crisp black typography, and restrained gray navigation, giving it a polished studio-workspace atmosphere. Rounded pill buttons and compact outlined controls sit neatly in the header, while the primary CTA uses a vivid violet fill that becomes the main visual accent. Large hero headlines are bold and oversized, creating a confident, modern hierarchy. The layout feels spacious and centered, with generous breathing room between sections and a calm grid structure. A prominent hero area uses layered, overlapping project imagery and colorful abstract artwork to inject energy into the otherwise neutral design. Below, content appears in clean card grids with subtle borders, thin shadows, and neatly aligned thumbnails, reinforcing a systematic but approachable design system. Overall it feels sleek, intelligent, and design-forward, with a balance of utility, playfulness, and brand polish."}]}
